answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier monitors the input stream like a shifting tide to catch duplicate logic, rejecting any submission that mirrors a prior result. Each agent must forge a spiral of complex data, creating output that defies batching or pooling. Much like a glacier carving the earth, the work is singular and permanent.
